title: The drill's live rebuild (SPEC Appendix C): C4 with the naive columns only
notes: Opt-in: the default reconcile run (C1-C5, C5b and L) skips C4r; run it with --checks C4r. It runs on a copy of the model that holds Open Backlog EOP and nothing else, against expected/<profile>/C4r.csv, which is C4 without the two Fast columns.
36 month ends x 6 boroughs, Check Row the constant 1 on every row; the 12 month ends outside the window are all BLANK and must be present (SPEC 9.4).

Comparison per SPEC 9.4: counts and whole numbers exact; hours, ratios and averages relative tolerance 1e-9; BLANK and 0 are different values; booleans, dates and text exact after the display format is normalised (True/TRUE, 8/31/2026 12:00:00 AM, 1,234, 12.5%).
